Based on iter-1 canonical 6-param config (img_n_bf=proj_n_bf=1, all sigmas at Wagner defaults, n_iter=400) so this is a clean single-knob A/B vs iter-1. FAILURE MODE (hr stuck 0 over iters 1-4): every iter lands PSNR ~35.6 dB, ~1.0 dB BELOW the LD-FBP baseline 36.56 dB; the 6-param bilateral DEGRADES an already-clean dense-view (2304-angle) FBP. The sigma/depth levers are exhausted and INERT or HARMFUL: iter-2 img_n_bf 1->3 (PSNR 35.597->35.692, SSIM 0.9462->0.9452, hr 0); iter-3 img_sr 0.02->0.005 (PSNR 35.597->35.600, a no-op); iter-4 proj_sr 0.02->0.0005 moved PSNR the WRONG way 35.597->35.515 (tightening proj range HURT, not helped). All four ran warm_start=True, so the per-scan Adam fit was always seeded from a warm_state that already encoded the over-smoothing N2I optimum learned amortized on the train split -- biasing every scan into the smoothing regime that sits below the FBP before the per-scan fit even starts. HYPOTHESIS: warm_start=False removes that biased init -- each scan is fit fresh from the unsaturated sigma defaults, so the 400-step grad-clipped per-scan N2I fit reaches a gentler per-scan optimum that preserves edges and recovers recon PSNR toward/above the 36.56 dB LD-FBP baseline, lifting hr off 0. This is the LAST untried structural lever with the correct SIGN of effect (n_iter-up and pretrain_epochs-up both drive MORE N2I-target fitting = MORE over-smoothing, the wrong direction). Everything else held at iter-1 (pretrain_epochs/n_iter/grad_clip/lr/proj_n_bf/img_n_bf/val_n/seed, default img+proj sigmas). Per-image N2I (commit 1f4c3394), scored by evaluate_calibrated on L277 val. NOT amortized. If this ALSO fails to clear hr 0, the per-image bilateral-N2I is confirmed converging to the documented 6-param structural ceiling (~0.95, like dd-bf-supervised capped 0.9502): the half-view N2I info loss < the full-view 2304-angle FBP it tries to denoise, so no 6-param BF init can clear the baseline. Future iters should pivot to DOCUMENTING that ceiling (capacity/data/seed probes that show WHY it holds) rather than chasing hr>0.
